name: Mumbai
title: Mumbai: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Mumbai, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: Mumbai has a climate action plan that names urban heat, a climate budget and a heat implementation pathway written with C40, but no standalone heat action plan was found. Reporters describe a climate cell short of staff and parks closed in the hottest hours; volunteers and a small design firm work on cooling homes in informal settlements.
